data_points.claim: The latest comps say Knight Earthworks LLC, Limerick, Maine, serving York County and southern Maine since 2013.
The line used across the comps is Built right from the ground up, with granite and paver hardscapes, drainage, and excavation.
Will Knight is named as the owner-operator. Hours on the comps are Mon–Fri, 8am–4pm. The phone is (207) 699-6340.
Earlier comps in the same set say Biddeford Pool instead of Limerick. Both cannot be the on-screen town.

common_questions: Who do I call for a patio or drainage job in southern Maine?
Is Knight Earthworks based in Limerick or Biddeford Pool?
What has to be done under a patio before the stone is set?

misconceptions.myth: The finished patio is the whole job.
misconceptions.reality: The comps say the base prep and drainage are what keep patios, walls, and steps from settling.

audience_insights.knowledge_level: A homeowner who already has the brand kit in front of them.
pain_points: Settling patios and steps when the base was skipped.
